Hello, I am a postdoctoral researcher at ESSEC Paris under the supervision of Pierre Jacob. We are working on couplings for MCMC

Before that I was a postodoctoral researcher at Paris Dauphine under the supervision of Christian Robert, working on new conceptions of privacy.

Before that I was a PhD student at the University of Edinburgh under the supervision of Sotirios Sabanis, where we worked on stochastic processes.

I am interested probability, particularly the modelling of privacy, and the behaviour of SDEs in singular settings

My current email timothy.johnston at dauphine.psl.eu
